name: Cryostasis · Death ×2 · Fire
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Heals 1.75 ❤
• Regeneration: +0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 9 s
• Growth: up to 5 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 6 s
• Withering: −0.75 ❤ per second for 7.5 s
• Life drain: 2.25 ❤ damage, you heal 1.17 ❤
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
